title: Signature identity sources, timestamps and revocation
acceptance: PFX/PKCS#12 identity import, signing and verification with typed errors; trust anchors, Windows certificate store, RFC 3161 timestamps and CRL/OCSP revocation are T-0267.
notes: Follow-up split from T-0241, which signs with a caller-supplied PEM and reports chain trust as None. This task adds PFX/PKCS#12 import, the Windows certificate store as an identity source, RFC 3161 timestamp tokens, revocation through CRL and OCSP with typed results, trust-anchor chain building so certificate_chain_trusted can be Some, and multi-signature/Perms groundwork. Feature-matrix rows stay `library` until the T-0245 shell task exposes verification results; no row is promoted here.
